interface Box<T> { value: T }
interface NullableBox<T> { value: T | null }
type Left = Box<Right>;
type Right = Box<Left>['value'];
type Linked = NullableBox<Link>;
type Link = NullableBox<Linked>['value'];
type Optional = Box<OptionalLink> | null;
type OptionalLink = Box<Optional>['value'];
type Pair<T> = Box<PairLink<T>>;
type PairLink<T> = Box<Pair<T>>['value'];
type Keys = Box<Names>;
type Names = keyof Box<Keys>;
const node: Linked = { value: { value: null } };
const optional: Optional = { value: null };
const pair: Pair<string> | null = null;
const keys: Keys = { value: 'value' };
console.log(node.value?.value, optional.value, pair, keys.value);
interface Container<T extends { value: unknown }> { value: T }
type Constrained = Container<Constrained>;
const constrained: Constrained | null = null;
console.log(constrained);
type InferredA = Box<InferredB>;
type InferredB = Box<InferredA>['value'] extends infer X ? X : never;
type ObjectA = Box<ObjectB>;
type ObjectB = Box<ObjectA>['value'] extends object ? Box<ObjectA>['value'] : never;
type PrimitiveA = Box<PrimitiveB>;
type PrimitiveB = Box<PrimitiveA>['value'] extends string ? never : Box<PrimitiveA>['value'];
const conditional: InferredA | ObjectA | PrimitiveA | null = null;
console.log(conditional);
type BooleanA = Box<BooleanB>;
type BooleanB = Box<BooleanA>['value'] extends boolean ? never : Box<BooleanA>['value'];
type UnknownA = Box<UnknownB>;
type UnknownB = Box<UnknownA>['value'] extends {} | null | undefined ? Box<UnknownA>['value'] : never;
type TuplePrimitive = Box<TuplePrimitiveLink>;
type TuplePrimitiveLink = [Box<TuplePrimitive>['value']] extends [number] ? never : Box<TuplePrimitive>['value'];
type TupleInfer = Box<TupleInferLink>;
type TupleInferLink = [Box<TupleInfer>['value']] extends [infer X] ? X : never;
type Empty = {};
type Intersected = Box<IntersectedLink>;
type IntersectedLink = Box<Intersected>['value'] & {} extends object ? Box<Intersected>['value'] : never;
type ReversedEmpty = Box<ReversedEmptyLink>;
type ReversedEmptyLink = Empty & Box<ReversedEmpty>['value'] extends number ? never : Box<ReversedEmpty>['value'];
const nodeWithEmpty: Intersected = { value: {} as Intersected };
console.log(typeof nodeWithEmpty.value);
interface BoundBox<T extends {}> { value: T }
interface RequiredBox<T extends { value: any }> { value: T }
interface OptionalBox<T extends { value?: unknown }> { value: T }
type Plain = BoundBox<PlainLink>;
type PlainLink = BoundBox<Plain>['value'];
type Conditional = RequiredBox<ConditionalLink>;
type ConditionalLink = RequiredBox<Conditional>['value'] extends object ? RequiredBox<Conditional>['value'] : never;
type Inferred = OptionalBox<InferredLink>;
type InferredLink = OptionalBox<Inferred>['value'] extends infer X ? X : never;
type Projected = RequiredBox<ProjectedLink>;
type ProjectedLink = RequiredBox<Projected>['value'] & object;
type BoxArray = BoundBox<ArrayLink>;
type ArrayLink = BoundBox<BoxArray>['value'][];
type Tuple = BoundBox<TupleLink>;
type TupleLink = [BoundBox<Tuple>['value']];
type Union = BoundBox<UnionLink>;
type UnionLink = BoundBox<Union>['value'] | string;
type CustomRead<T> = { readonly [K in keyof T]: T[K] };
type Frozen = Box<FrozenLink>;
type FrozenLink = Readonly<Box<Frozen>['value']>;
type PartialNode = Box<PartialLink>;
type PartialLink = Partial<Box<PartialNode>['value']>;
type RequiredNode = Box<RequiredLink>;
type RequiredLink = Required<Box<RequiredNode>['value']>;
type CustomNode = Box<CustomLink>;
type CustomLink = CustomRead<Box<CustomNode>['value']>;
const frozen: Frozen = { value: { value: {} as FrozenLink } };
const partial: PartialNode = { value: {} };
console.log(typeof frozen.value, partial.value.value);
type ExpandArray<T> = Box<ExpandArrayLink<T>>;
type ExpandArrayLink<T> = Box<ExpandArray<T[]>>['value'];
type ExpandTuple<T> = Box<ExpandTupleLink<T>>;
type ExpandTupleLink<T> = Box<ExpandTuple<[T]>>['value'];
type ExpandBox<T> = Box<ExpandBoxLink<T>>;
type ExpandBoxLink<T> = Box<ExpandBox<Box<T>>>['value'];
type ExpandRecord<T> = Box<ExpandRecordLink<T>>;
type ExpandRecordLink<T> = Box<ExpandRecord<{ payload: T }>>['value'];
const expandedArray: ExpandArray<number> = { value: { value: {} as any } };
const expandedTuple: ExpandTuple<string> = { value: { value: {} as any } };
const expandedBox: ExpandBox<number> = { value: { value: {} as any } };
const expandedRecord: ExpandRecord<boolean> = { value: { value: {} as any } };
console.log(typeof expandedArray.value, typeof expandedTuple.value, typeof expandedBox.value, typeof expandedRecord.value);
